title: Practice 2: Doing it fully, to the end

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does у- add in утаи́ть (“to conceal, to keep to oneself, to keep a secret”)?
options: completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
settling or placing something thoroughly, comfortably or for long
keeping in the state the base verb names
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists утаи́ть under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does по- add in поза́втракать (“to have breakfast, to breakfast, to lunch”)?
options: doing the action for some time
completing an action, covering its object fully or in part
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists поза́втракать under this meaning of по-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «по-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/по-).

exercises.q: What does по- add in подви́нуть (“to move a little”)?
options: completing an action, covering its object fully or in part
doing the action for some time
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists подви́нуть under this meaning of по-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «по-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/по-).

exercises.q: What does под- add in подписа́ть (“to sign (one's own name)”)?
options: alternative form of под- (used before certain consonant clusters)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists подписа́ть under this meaning of под-. Source: Wiktionary, «под-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/под-#Russian).
**подпишу** — подписа́ть (perfective): to sign (one's own name); to add to; to subscribe, to take out a subscription for someone. Wiktionary: под- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to enhance, to upgrade, to improve, to refine
to conceal, to keep to oneself, to keep a secret
to have breakfast, to breakfast, to lunch
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: усоверше́нствовать — to enhance, to upgrade, to improve, to refine; утаи́ть — to conceal, to keep to oneself, to keep a secret; поза́втракать — to have breakfast, to breakfast, to lunch; подви́нуть — to move a little.
**подпишет** — подписа́ть (perfective): to sign (one's own name); to add to; to subscribe, to take out a subscription for someone. Wiktionary: под- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does на- add in напи́ться (“to quench thirst”)?
options: a quantity of, a lot of
to repletion, to satiation, to the full, enough, too much
(added to nouns, forms adverbs with the meaning in the direction of the noun)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists напи́ться under this meaning of на-. Source: Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).

exercises.q: What does за- add in заду́мать (“to devise”)?
options: (with a reflexive verb) to do with abandonment
describing an intensified or extreme action or an action of doing something up to the point that an object becomes junk
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists заду́мать under this meaning of за-. Source: Wiktionary, «за-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-#Russian).

exercises.q: What does из- add in изму́читься (“to suffer”)?
options: destroying, reducing to nothing by use
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists изму́читься under this meaning of из-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in всма́триваться (“to scrutinize, to peer, to look carefully”)?
options: giving or acquiring a status or state
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists всма́триваться under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: подписа́ть — to sign (one's own name); напи́ться — to quench thirst; заду́мать — to devise; изму́читься — to suffer.
